method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited texts with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (lpc-core.l4) with three regulative rules (cl 31(1) with cl 34(4)-(5); cl 34(2); cl 37(4)) run by EVALTRACE inside functions that take only plain facts; one seat layer (the client) that restates no rule; answers are named outcomes, numbers or dates, no MAYBE BOOLEAN, so no NOTHING-kind tags; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
focus: costs agreements (Schedule 3, costs disclosure and adjudication)
edition_encoded: From the official South Australian register (legislation.sa.gov.au), unauthorised RTF renderings retrieved 2026-11-06, not the Open Australian Legal Corpus: Legal Practitioners Act 1981 at version 1.9.2026, deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/legal-practitioners-act-1981.txt (text sha256 b0ad6e5aa17acbb45a6757a26a71a655310c750d8dcad402dd2ab16b22e658bf per its meta.json), s 41 and Schedule 3; Legal Practitioners Regulations 2014 at version 1.7.2020, deposited at subjects/au/sa/legal-practitioners-regulations-2014/registers/source-bundle/legal-practitioners-regulations-2014.txt (text sha256 e896151893c46a2b4256a9666538f6e53f50b1e16ddb65f275885732a13f3eb0 per its meta.json), regs 58, 60, 61, 62. Matters first instructed on or after 1 July 2014. The Cash Rate Target and the scale or fair value of work are inputs.

seat: the client: the person who retains a law practice for a matter and pays its legal costs, for example someone injured under a no win, no fee costs agreement (lpc-seat.l4)

checks.result: 147 assertions written, 147 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07); a negative control (cl 26(4)(b) 25% to 26%, cl 13(1)(a) $1 500 to $1 499) failed exactly the 4 predicted assertions and was discarded
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: In: Schedule 3 cll 1-5, 9, 11(2), 12, 13, 18, 19, 23, Part 5 in full (cll 24-30), 31, 34, 37(4)-(5), 44, 47, 49, 51; Regulations regs 58, 60, 61, 62. Out: cl 8 (matters moving between jurisdictions), cll 10, 14-17, 20 (content and form of each disclosure; their consequence, cl 18, is in), cll 21-22 except as used, 32-33, 35, the court's process in Part 7 (cll 37(1)-(3), (6)-(9), 38-43, 45, 46, 48, 50), machinery (cll 7, 52, 53, regulation powers), and the rest of the Act. Reasons in NOTES.md.
